content: To steal the red Phoenix in Grand Theft Auto 6 during the "Unwanted Attention" mission, you must choose between two tactics: go in guns-blazing, or rely on stealth. Since this is one of your first missions, you may be inclined to barge into the police impound and see what happens, but this will make the mission much harder. With the right tactics, however, reclaiming the red Phoenix (and the weed in the trunk) is a breeze.
